formulario.texto: This gives the building its profile and puts it in the portfolio. Everything else comes later.
formulario.nombreAyuda: What the team calls it. E.g.: Rolher Building
formulario.chipAyuda: Cadastral code of the lot. If it is already registered, the existing profile opens.
formulario.direccionAyuda: Cadastral address if you have it; otherwise the one on the plate.
formulario.matriculaAyuda: From the certificate of title. Can be added later.
formulario.origenAyuda: How it came in: known owner, walk-through, RenoBo, referral.
formulario.contactoAyuda: Name and phone or email. Only the team sees it.
formulario.coordenadasAyuda: Optional. Right-click in Google Maps → copy coordinates. Places the building on the map.
queSigue: Get the certificate of title, the cadastral certificate and the planning lookup in Mapas Bogotá online.
Meet the owner with the document list and do the site visit.
Build the list of candidate uses and run the screening.
If it passes, complete the detailed study (checklist A–F) and run the highest and best use analysis.

documentos.texto: Full list to start the study (Torna, October 27, 2026). Change each document's status and upload the file when you have it. With the five marked as minimum you can already run the screening.
documentos.filtroNoAplica: Hide those that do not apply
documentos.leyenda: Online: downloaded or looked up on the internet · Partial: looked up online, but the full document is requested separately · Offline: held by the owner or must be produced.
documentos.notasEj: E.g.: requested from the owner on Nov 3; arrives next week.
documentos.errorTamano: The file is larger than {max} MB.
documentos.confirmarQuitar: Remove "{nombre}"? The file is deleted from storage.

checklist.titulo: Highest and best use guide checklist
checklist.texto: Blocks A to F of Torna's guide. Mark each item as meets, to verify, does not meet or not applicable, with a note if needed. Blocking items turn the screening red when they do not meet.

preguntas.legal: Do the rules allow this use, at this intensity and with this heritage status?
preguntas.fisica: Can the building take this use without works that make it unviable?
preguntas.financiera: Is there someone to pay for it, at what price and how soon?

checklist.notaEj: What was found and where it comes from (document and page).

usos.texto: Each use is a column of the decision matrix (block G). It takes the tests in order: rules, building and demand. When a use fails a test, the column closes. For the survivors, fill in the block F numbers.
usos.vacioTexto: Add at least one from the list above to run the screening.
usos.numerosTexto: With these the platform computes income, yield, payback, IRR, NPV and sensitivities. Colombian pesos.
usos.m2NetosAyuda: Real leasable or sellable area, not gross.
usos.canonM2Ayuda: From the comparables study (5 to 10 per use).
usos.inversionAyuda: Works, retrofit, design, permits, fees and contingencies.
usos.gastosAnualesAyuda: Property tax, management, maintenance, insurance, commissions.
usos.errorGuardar: Could not save. Check the numbers.

errores.faltaMinimo: The minimum documents are missing or there are no candidate uses.
errores.faltanNumeros: The numbers for the surviving uses are incomplete.
errores.generico: The analysis could not run. Try again.

tamizaje.texto: With the minimum documents and the list of uses, the platform checks for blockers in papers, rules and building and says whether the property deserves the detailed study.

lectura.verde: No blockers: the property deserves the detailed study.
lectura.amarillo: There are non-blocking pending items. Complete them and run again.
lectura.rojo: There is at least one blocker. Resolve it or discard the property with the written reason.

tamizaje.pendientes: Items to resolve (A, B and quick test)

mmu.texto: Runs each use through the four tests in order, computes the block F numbers and fills the decision matrix. Formulas, not AI: every figure can be traced.
mmu.reqSobreviven: At least one use passes rules and building
mmu.reqNumeros: Complete numbers for the surviving uses
mmu.reqBloques: Blocks D, E and F resolved
mmu.loteAyuda: If known, it is compared with the building's best use.
mmu.ningunoTexto: No use beats the hurdle rate with the current numbers. Review investment, rent or occupancy.
mmu.porque: Yield of {rentabilidad} and NPV of {vpn}. It leaves the most risk-adjusted value.
mmu.loteVacio: The vacant lot is worth more than the building's best use: the building is no longer the best use.

motivos.tasa: Negative NPV at the hurdle rate

mmu.nota: NPV and IRR on monthly cash flows: investment in month 0, no income until the first-income month, then the monthly net and, at the end of the horizon, the exit value (net income ÷ cap rate). Viable: NPV ≥ 0 at the hurdle rate. Adjusted value: NPV × 1.0 (low risk), 0.9 (medium) or 0.8 (high).
mmu.salidaAyuda: Default 12%. Property's value at the end: net income ÷ rate.

ayuda.2: Get the certificate of title, the cadastral certificate and the planning lookup online; upload permits and the site visit.
ayuda.3: Score Torna's 5 filters with what you already have: the minimum documents and the visit.
ayuda.4: Add the uses worth testing in this building.
ayuda.5: Run the screening to know whether the property deserves the detailed study.
ayuda.6: Resolve the A–F checklist items with the documents and studies.
ayuda.7: Fill in each use's numbers and run the highest and best use analysis.
ayuda.8: Review the report, fix it and export it as PDF for the owner.

informe.etiqueta: Feasibility report · Highest and best use
informe.borrador: Draft: the highest and best use analysis has not been run yet. The report is completed with the matrix and the recommendation.

cap.2: Property identification and title study (block A)
cap.4: Physical assessment and net areas (block C)
cap.6: Market study for each candidate use (block E)
cap.7: Financial model and sensitivities by use (block F)
cap.8: Decision matrix and recommended use or mix (block G)
cap.9: Risks and how to mitigate them
cap.10: Next steps, schedule and pending documents

informe.porque: The rules allow it, the building can take it and there is demand. Yield of {rentabilidad}, NPV of {vpn} and payback in {recuperacion} years.
informe.parametros: Parameters: hurdle rate {tasa}, {anios}-year horizon, exit cap rate {salida}.
informe.sinMatriz: The matrix is filled when the highest and best use analysis runs.
informe.riesgoAlto: {uso}: high risk according to the team.
informe.fragil: {uso}: with rent 10% lower it drops below the hurdle rate.
informe.loteVacio: The vacant lot is worth more than the building's best use.
informe.pie: Report generated by Torna's platform with the data validated by the team. Financial calculations are formulas on the entered data; they do not replace the IDPC opinion, the IDIGER certification, the structural visit (NSR-10) or the permit from the curaduría.

filtros.texto: Quick screening to decide whether the property deserves the detailed study. Each filter has a veto criterion that rules out at once and criteria scored 0 to 2. It can be filled with the minimum documents and the site visit.
filtros.radar: Chart of the 5 filters. Total potential {potencial} out of 100.
filtros.notaEj: What was seen and where it comes from.
filtros.vetosFallidos: A veto criterion is not met ({codigos}). Discard the property or resolve that point before going on.

explica.alto: {alto} or more: go to the detailed study.
explica.medio: Between {medio} and {alto}: go ahead with conditions; low filters show what to study first.
explica.bajo: Below {medio}: discard unless there is a written strategic reason.
explica.descartar: A veto criterion is not met.
explica.incompleto: Veto criteria are missing or fewer than 60% of the criteria are scored.

metodo: Transformation Meter method (Geraedts and van der Voordt, TU Delft), cited in Torna's guide: vetoes first, then gradual criteria.
Each filter's score = points ÷ (2 × scored criteria), from 0 to 100. Unscored criteria do not subtract.
Total potential = weighted average: rules 25%, structure 25%, location 20%, surroundings 15%, history 15%.
Reading: 70 or more, high · 50 to 69, medium · below 50, low. A veto marked «does not meet» rules out.
The screening uses this result together with the checklist: the most severe color wins.
